edges: Edward and Edith are siblings and orphans living in the New Forest.
Edward and Humphrey adapt from an aristocratic lifestyle to that of simple foresters under Jacob Armitage's guidance.
Edward and his siblings rescued Pablo, a gypsy boy, from a pitfall trap.
Corbould seeks to harm Edward and his family.
Edward encounters Heatherstone, who is in charge of the Royal land in the New Forest.
Edward rescues Patience, Heatherstone's daughter, in a house-fire.
Edward works as a secretary for Heatherstone.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Heatherstone acquired the Arnwood estate for Edward.

edges: Edward and Humphrey are brothers and orphans living in the New Forest.
Edward and Alice are siblings and orphans living in the New Forest.
Edward joins the army of the future King Charles II.
Edward returns to the New Forest after the Royalist defeat at the Battle of Worcester.
Edward flees to France due to disillusionment and Patience's apparent rejection of his love.
Edward learns that Patience loves him.
Edward works as a mercenary soldier in exile until the Restoration when he and Patience are reunited.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Heatherstone acquired the Arnwood estate for Edward.
